base.previous: P54 2/2 authored Gaussian-model DEV positive, no independent scientific pass

hypothesis: A conventional model fitted from the same actual logged physical action/outcome records that learns Laplace cue and probe noise scales will earn > Gaussian-assumed P54 model on unfamiliar heavy-tail cue/probe/reward worlds, while choosing useful paid probes without unexecuted labels.

source.environment: new authored DEV two-step binary hidden sign + noisy cue + optional executed diagnostic + executed signed final action reward minus diagnostic cost
source.noise: independent zero-centered Laplace distribution with variance 1 (scale=1/sqrt(2)) for cue, executed probe, and post-action reward, non-Gaussian
source.logging: same actually executed randomized 50% paid probe, independently randomized final sign, and physically observed noisy net reward for every fitted conventional policy
source.source_privacy: fit API receives only visible prior, executed probe flag, actually observed probe measurement or exactly zero if no probe, actually executed final signed action and its physically observed net reward; latent sign, unchosen probe result and noise tape evaluator-only

comparators.P54_Gaussian: exact original P54.fit_moments() from same NEW 850001 factual logger; exact P54.decisions() Gaussian noise decision rule but with physical Laplace evaluator; all fitted Gaussian parameters, no source oracle
comparators.Laplace_fitted: learn signal gain scales, prior sign and cue/probe second-moment residual variance from same executed-action noisy reward log via unchanged P54.fit_moments(); infer a Laplace noise family using learned variance/2 as b², posterior based on absolute-deviation likelihood, analytically calculate value of a paid probe
comparators.Laplace_model_aware: knows true Laplace noise shape and true cue/probe gain/noise scaling, prior=0.5; not fair learner, ceiling
comparators.Laplace_fitted_never: same learned posterior but never probe
comparators.Laplace_fitted_always: same learned posterior but always pay for probe
comparators.wrong_credit: P54.shuffled_credit_log applied to same new FIT log, then Laplace fitted; verify no oracle labels
comparators.sham_no_information: zero physical probe signal, positive physical cost, must never probe

training.neural_training: NOT RUN; this gate isolates whether P54 Gaussian assumption caused a model-class transfer failure; P54 architecture PRs remain separate

all_ood_cohorts: Laplace-fitted net reward >= same-fitted never probe +0.02
Laplace-fitted net reward >= Gaussian-fitted P54 net reward +0.01
Laplace-fitted within 0.025 net reward of known-Laplace oracle
actual Laplace fitted probe fraction between 0.05 and 0.95
paired 95% bootstrap lower-bound improvement versus fitted never strictly positive, exactly 1000 resamples, seeds 850901 + OOD seed
weak cue with strong probe gain: <0.2 price probe fraction >= >=0.4 price probe fraction + 0.15, groups each >=30
negative_controls: Laplace-fitted reward exceeds wrong credit by 0.025 on both OOD
source rejects any unexecuted probe measurement and oracle theta keys
bit-exact cold replay of fitted sufficient stats and physically executed decisions
frozen_gates.nonpass_disposition: Record exact negative, no threshold/seed hindsight revision or subsequent source first-use reclassification
frozen_gates.science: Even if all authored DEV gates pass, independent SCIENTIFIC_PASS is NOT established; real unfamiliar physical benchmark, trained conventional neural controls under equal compute, multi-step retention still missing.
